content:
Following the "Surprise and Shine" event held in September, Apple has released the RC (Release Candidate) versions of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, and others.

The RC versions including iPadOS 27 are available for testing starting today.

Apple's new major software updates for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and more are about to arrive.

iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27 will be officially released to all users next Monday (September 14).

After a full summer of beta testing, Apple today officially released the RC versions of the aforementioned updates.

Developers and public beta testers can install the RC versions including iPadOS 27 through the "Software Update" screen in "Settings".

The release candidate is theoretically the final software version to be released to all users. However, if Apple discovers any major issues that need to be fixed, we may see an RC 2 version released in a short period of time.

It has been a longstanding practice for Apple to release the RC versions of new major software immediately after its annual iPhone launch event concludes.

The reason is that some new features not announced at WWDC are often saved for the September event to be unveiled. For example, Apple detailed some of the watchOS 27 changes at today's Apple Watch hardware launch event, which were never mentioned in June — these are now available to try on the watchOS 27 RC.

Did you find anything new in Apple's RC versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
